items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: Well, went into the electrical business with the football player, you remember, Irish Levy?

ctx.x: Well look for it and I'll talk about this picture. Yeah, well, here. I noticed Elrey Mace is playing the Albert System clarinet and he and Dave apparently double on baritone. They're playing alto. There it is, yeah. Okay. And here you are with the bass. Yeah, I had bass fiddle, yeah. In the small owls. Yeah. Good question. Well, what happened to Errol Crum?

Well, went into the electrical business with the football player, you remember, Irish Levy? No, I never heard such a name. Yeah, that was back in the, well, he was the famous guard that never wore a helmet. He was on the Ladenslager team.
I should have remembered that name, but I don't.
